newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World Infra to issue 84 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: New World Infra to issue 84 mln new shrs.

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd plans to issue 84 million new shares to its major shareholder after the parent places the same amount of existing shares at HK$24.30 per share, sources close to the deal said.
New World Infrastructure is a subsidiary of New World Development Co Ltd.
New World Infrastructure officials were not immediately available for comment.

The existing placement shares represent about nine percent of the company's issued share capital and the placement price a three percent discount to New World Infrastructure's closing price on Tuesday, the sources said .
New World Infrastructure shares rose HK$0.45 to end at HK$25.05 on Tuesday.
"The shares were placed to institutions and had been more than two times subscribed," one source close to the deal said.
Credit Lyonnais and Tai Fook Securities are the placing agents, the sources added.
New World Development Co Ltd held about 62.9 percent of New World Infrastructure as of April 1997.

The main business of New World Infrastructure is to develop, own, operate and/or manage toll roads, expressways, tunnels and bridges, power stations, container terminals, cargo handling and storage facilities, and cement manufacturing in Hong Kong and China.
